read: work-queue {} returns ok, stale_after_hours, github[] {repo,state,reason?,observed_at?,truncated?} and jobs[] in priority order. Each job has card_id WRn.Sm.Jk, work_request, work_request_title, slice_ordinal, j_number, priority, executor, model, effort, card_title, description, created_at, stage (queued|build|review|merged|closed), stale and prs[] {repo,number,url,title,draft,state,updated_at,card_id WRn.Sm.Jk.repo#pr}.
review: Stage, PR links and staleness are derived by the server from Card lines on GitHub PRs; the page never recomputes them. A github source that is not ok means its PR stages may be behind and the page says so.
refresh: One work-queue call per 60-second refresh through mountAutoRefresh, none while hidden, none after 5 idle minutes. The published carr-v5 snapshot is read once for costs and never polled.
deployment_order: Hold auto-merge until server PR #2547 is merged and the work-queue verb is live in production.
